howto.what: 分析代码库，找出与性能场景相关的代码路径、入口点和热点文件，并列出候选文件及调用链。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析性能场景的代码路径，或在进行性能分析前需要映射代码结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出这个性能场景的代码路径。
say.note: 触发分析，列出候选文件和符号。

say.text: 分析用户登录流程的热点文件。
say.note: 指定场景，输出相关路径和调用链。

howto.what_en: Analyze the codebase to identify code paths, entry points, and hot files related to a performance scenario, listing candidate files and call chains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to map code paths for a performance scenario or before profiling to understand code structure.

say_en.text: Find the code paths for this performance scenario.
say_en.note: Triggers analysis, listing candidate files and symbols.

say_en.text: Analyze hot files for the user login flow.
